checks.identity: Ending equity − initial equity = total PnL
Hold benchmark − initial equity = inventory PnL
Ending equity − hold benchmark = execution contribution
Total PnL = inventory PnL + execution contribution
Final BTC − initial BTC = ending extra BTC
